entries.reason: the key that asks for an array texture when possible, exported with the value the header's own name spells, which is what a caller passing the NSString it read out of the header needs; the value was measured out of Apple's own framework rather than assumed, and the measurement is the harness the facts file names
entries.effect: the option key the application passes in the loader's options dictionary is the same NSString Apple's is, so the loader can read it; what it can then do with it is the subject of the next entry and of the refusals in the facts file
entries.source: SDK 26.2, MetalKit, MTKTextureLoader.h:130; and Apple's own MetalKit framework, measured by tests/backports/host/metal-census/loaderoptions.sh

entries.reason: the MDLTexture's channel count and channel encoding are mapped onto one of the nine Metal pixel formats this port holds, the texels are read in the row order this port's textures are written in - which MTKTextureLoaderOptionOrigin picks between the MDLTexture's own two accessors, so no rows are copied - and the bytes are written through -replaceRegion:; a channel count or encoding with no format of that shape, an sRGB request, a cube layout and a cube are each refused with the reason as the error's description
entries.effect: an MDLTexture of one, two or four 8-bit, 16-bit float or 32-bit float channels becomes a real Metal texture of the matching format with the texels the MDLTexture holds; anything this port cannot hold answers nil and an NSError in MTKTextureLoaderErrorDomain naming what it was given
entries.source: SDK 26.2, MetalKit, MTKTextureLoader.h:330; the format table is facts/Metal/PixelFormats.md

entries.reason: the asynchronous form of the synchronous one, and the header's own contract for it is a block called with the texture or with the error; it calls that block with the pair the synchronous method returns, so there is one implementation of the loading and not two
entries.effect: the handler is called with the Metal texture and a nil error, or with nil and the error the synchronous method set; the header declares the block nonnull, so a caller that passes nil has nothing called
